title: Call logs
subtitle: Inspect routing, token usage and latency of every data-plane request
emptyHint: No requests match the selected time range. Try adjusting the filters.

detail.title: Log details
detail.noAttempts: No upstream attempts recorded (the request may have been blocked or rate-limited at the gateway)
detail.clientWriteHint: Time blocked writing/flushing to the client during streaming; upstream latency minus this approximates pure upstream wait. A large value points at the client or reverse proxy
detail.firstByteHint: From request arrival to the upstream response headers, including queueing and earlier failed attempts; not when the client sees the first text
detail.firstContentHint: When the first event carrying generated content (text, thinking or a tool call) was written to the client, from request arrival; for non-streaming, when the body was written
detail.queueWaitHint: Time waiting for a gateway / group / key concurrency slot; 0 means no queueing

costUnpriced: No matching price for this model; add one under Settings → Pricing
costPartial: Partially priced: an attempt had unknown or incomplete usage; the actual cost is at least this
costUnverified: The currency of this pre-upgrade record could not be established; the raw amount is kept in the database and counted nowhere
